sql.if: AND ( t1.medata_set_nm ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{srchText}, '%') OR t1.medata_set_logic_nm ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{srchText}, '%') )
AND t1.medata_set_amd_dt < TO_TIMESTAMP(#{srchEndDd} || ' 00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') + INTERVAL '1 day'
AND t3.medata_val ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND t6.data_type_mtcd IN ('keywordsKr', 'keywordsEn')

choose.when: ORDER BY t7.model_prpty_sort_odrg DESC , t5.prpty_sort_odrg DESC
ORDER BY t3.medata_val COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" /* 한글 정렬 */ DESC
ORDER BY t1.medata_set_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" /* 한글 정렬 */ DESC , t7.model_prpty_sort_odrg, t5.prpty_sort_odrg
ORDER BY t1.medata_set_logic_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" /* 한글 정렬 */ DESC , t7.model_prpty_sort_odrg, t5.prpty_sort_odrg
ORDER BY t3.medata_val COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" /* 한글 정렬 */ DESC

mapper.select: SELECT /* SQL_ID: MetadataMapper.selectMetadataCount */ COUNT(*) FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model t2 ON t1.model_id = t2.model_id INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_data t3 ON t1.medata_set_id = t3.medata_set_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_property t5 ON t3.prpty_id = t5.prpty_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model t6 ON t3.val_model_id = t6.model_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code c3 ON t6.data_type_mtcd = c3.mtcd AND c3.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00013' WHERE 1=1

SELECT /* SQL_ID: MetadataMapper.selectMetadataList */ t3.medata_id , t3.medata_set_id , t3.prpty_id , t3.lang_mtcd , t3.medata_val , dtmeta.ST_AsGeoJson(t3.geodata_val) AS geodata_val , t1.medata_set_nm , t1.medata_set_logic_nm , t1.medata_set_sttus_mtcd , c1.mtcd_nm AS medata_set_sttus_mtcd_nm , t4.model_nm AS type_model_nm , t4.model_logic_nm AS type_model_logic_nm , t2.model_nm , t2.model_logic_nm , t5.prpty_nm , t5.prpty_logic_nm , t5.data_array_yn , t6.model_nm AS val_model_nm , t6.model_logic_nm AS val_model_logic_nm FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model t2 ON t1.model_id = t2.model_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model t4 ON t2.type_model_id = t4.model_id INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_data t3 ON t1.medata_set_id = t3.medata_set_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_property t5 ON t3.prpty_id = t5.prpty_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model t6 ON t3.val_model_id = t6.model_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_modelproperty t7 ON t3.model_prpty_id = t7.model_prpty_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code c1 ON t1.medata_set_sttus_mtcd = c1.mtcd AND c1.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00001' LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code c3 ON t6.data_type_mtcd = c3.mtcd AND c3.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00013' WHERE 1=1

sql.if: AND ( t3.medata_set_nm ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{medataValNm}, '%') OR t3.medata_set_logic_nm ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{medataValNm}, '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT /* SQL_ID: MetadataMapper.selectMetadataCountByPropertyNm */ COUNT(*) FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_data t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_property t2 ON t1.prpty_id = t2.prpty_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset t3 ON t1.medata_val = t3.medata_set_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model t4 ON t1.val_model_id = t4.model_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code c1 ON t3.medata_set_sttus_mtcd = c1.mtcd AND c1.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00001' WHERE t2.prpty_nm = #{prptyNm}

SELECT /* SQL_ID: MetadataMapper.selectMetadataListByPropertyNm */ t1.medata_id , t1.medata_set_id , t1.prpty_id , t1.val_model_id , t1.model_prpty_id , t1.lang_mtcd , t1.medata_val , dtmeta.ST_AsGeoJson(t1.geodata_val) AS geodata_val , t3.medata_set_nm AS medata_val_nm , TO_CHAR(t3.medata_set_amd_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS medata_val_amd_dt , t3.model_id AS medata_val_model_id , c1.mtcd_nm AS medata_val_sttus_mtcd_nm , t4.data_type_mtcd FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_data t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_property t2 ON t1.prpty_id = t2.prpty_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset t3 ON t1.medata_val = t3.medata_set_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model t4 ON t1.val_model_id = t4.model_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code c1 ON t3.medata_set_sttus_mtcd = c1.mtcd AND c1.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00001' WHERE t2.prpty_nm = #{prptyNm}
ORDER BY t1.medata_val COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" /* 한글 정렬 */ DESC
ORDER BY t3.medata_set_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" /* 한글 정렬 */ DESC
ORDER BY t1.medata_id DESC

SELECT /* SQL_ID: MetadataMapper.selectMetadataListByPropertyNmForDupCheck */ COUNT(*) OVER()::int AS cnt , t1.medata_id FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_data t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_property t2 ON t1.prpty_id = t2.prpty_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset t3 ON t1.medata_val = t3.medata_set_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model t4 ON t1.val_model_id = t4.model_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code c1 ON t3.medata_set_sttus_mtcd = c1.mtcd AND c1.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00001' WHERE t2.prpty_nm = #{prptyNm}

SELECT /* SQL_ID: MetadataMapper.selectMetadataPropertyListBySetIdForRequiredCheck */ m1.model_id , m1.prpty_id , m2.prpty_nm , m3.medata_set_id FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_modelproperty m1 INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_property m2 ON m1.prpty_id = m2.prpty_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT t1.medata_set_id , t1.model_id , t2.prpty_id , count(*) AS val_cnt FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset t1 INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_data t2 ON t1.medata_set_id = t2.medata_set_id WHERE t1.medata_set_id = #{medataSetId} AND ( (t2.medata_val IS NOT NULL AND t2.medata_val != '') OR (t2.geodata_val IS NOT NULL AND t2.geodata_val != '') ) GROUP BY t1.medata_set_id , t1.model_id , t2.prpty_id ) m3 ON m1.model_id = m3.model_id AND m1.prpty_id = m3.prpty_id WHERE m1.model_id = #{modelId} AND m1.model_prpty_mand_mtcd = 'required' AND m3.medata_set_id IS NULL

SELECT /* SQL_ID: MetadataMapper.selectMetadataPropertyListBySetIdForCountCheck */ m1.model_id , m1.prpty_id , m2.prpty_nm , m3.val_cnt FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_modelproperty m1 INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_property m2 ON m1.prpty_id = m2.prpty_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT t1.medata_set_id , t1.model_id , t2.prpty_id , count(*) AS val_cnt FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset t1 INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_data t2 ON t1.medata_set_id = t2.medata_set_id WHERE t1.medata_set_id = #{medataSetId} GROUP BY t1.medata_set_id , t1.model_id , t2.prpty_id ) m3 ON m1.model_id = m3.model_id AND m1.prpty_id = m3.prpty_id WHERE m1.model_id = #{modelId} AND m2.data_array_yn = 'N'
AND m3.val_cnt > 1

SELECT /* SQL_ID: MetadataMapper.selectMetadataValStatusListBySetIdForObjectTypeCheck */ t1.medata_set_id , t2.prpty_id , t3.prpty_nm , t2.val_model_id , t4.model_nm , t4.model_logic_nm , t2.medata_val , t5.medata_set_nm AS medata_val_nm , t5.medata_set_sttus_mtcd AS medata_val_sttus_mtcd , c1.mtcd_nm AS medata_val_sttus_mtcd_nm , t5.model_id AS medata_val_model_id FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset t1 INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_data t2 ON t1.medata_set_id = t2.medata_set_id INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_property t3 ON t2.prpty_id = t3.prpty_id INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model t4 ON t2.val_model_id = t4.model_id AND t4.model_type_mtcd = 'object_type' AND t4.structd_model_yn = 'N' LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset t5 ON t2.medata_val = t5.medata_set_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code c1 ON t5.medata_set_sttus_mtcd = c1.mtcd AND c1.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00001' WHERE t1.medata_set_id = #{medataSetId} AND t5.medata_set_sttus_mtcd != 'use' ORDER BY t3.prpty_sort_odrg

SELECT /* SQL_ID: MetadataMapper.selectMetadata */ t3.medata_id , t3.medata_set_id , t3.prpty_id , t3.val_model_id , t3.model_prpty_id , t3.lang_mtcd , t3.medata_val , dtmeta.ST_AsGeoJson(t3.geodata_val) AS geodata_val , t5.prpty_nm , t5.prpty_logic_nm , t5.data_array_yn , t5.prpty_scrn_indc_yn , t7.model_prpty_mand_mtcd , c2.mtcd_nm AS model_prpty_mand_mtcd_nm , t7.model_prpty_val_exam , CASE WHEN c3.mtcd IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS set_usg_prpty_yn , CASE WHEN t7.model_prpty_mand_mtcd = 'readonly' OR c3.mtcd IS NOT NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS editable_yn , CASE WHEN t6.data_type_mtcd = 'langString' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS lang_enable_yn , t6.data_type_mtcd , t6.model_nm AS val_model_nm , t6.model_logic_nm AS val_model_logic_nm , t6.model_type_mtcd AS val_model_type_mtcd , t8.medata_set_nm AS medata_val_nm FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_data t3 LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_property t5 ON t3.prpty_id = t5.prpty_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model t6 ON t3.val_model_id = t6.model_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_modelproperty t7 ON t3.model_prpty_id = t7.model_prpty_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset t8 ON t3.medata_val = t8.medata_set_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code c2 ON t7.model_prpty_mand_mtcd = c2.mtcd AND c2.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00004' LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code c3 ON t6.data_type_mtcd = c3.mtcd AND c3.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00013' WHERE t3.medata_id = #{medataId}

SELECT t1.prpty_id, t1.val_model_id, count(t2.medata_id) AS val_model_cnt FROM ( SELECT a3.prpty_id, a3.cnt_model_id AS val_model_id FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_model a1 INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_modelproperty a2 ON a1.model_id = a2.model_id INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_property a3 ON a2.prpty_id = a3.prpty_id WHERE a1.model_id = #{modelId} AND a2.model_prpty_del_yn = 'N' AND a3.cnt_prpty_yn = 'Y' ) t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_data t2 ON t1.val_model_id = t2.val_model_id AND t2.medata_set_id = #{medataSetId} GROUP BY t1.prpty_id, t1.val_model_id
